info.name: OpenVidu Integration
info.summary: Embed OpenVidu Meet video-conferencing rooms in Nextcloud
info.description:
OpenVidu Integration lets you create and join OpenVidu Meet video-conferencing rooms without leaving your Nextcloud instance. An administrator configures the OpenVidu Meet server URL once; users can then create named meeting rooms that are embedded directly in the Nextcloud UI.
Features: * Create persistent, named meeting rooms * Join meetings via an embedded iframe – no separate tab required * Manage your rooms from a clean Nextcloud-native dashboard * Admin settings for the OpenVidu Meet server URL
info.author: Patxi Gortázar
